method: Read all 33 components/core TSX implementations, both hooks, registry definitions/build/schema, utility/CSS/package imports, and listed representative docs/examples. Enumerated 95 documentation example TSX paths; did not claim to read every example. Static source inspection only; upstream browser/device conformance not tested. Local reusable adapters and substantial offline recipes distill mechanisms and document corrections rather than import source wholesale.

source_derived_api_notes.animation_units: Motion duration/delay/stagger in seconds; InfiniteSlider speed in pixels/second; raw spring damping coefficient is not a damping ratio.
